headline.scientific_meaning: SBG V5 AUROC 0.3877 is significantly below 0.5. The method does not detect semantic changes in QuixBugs programs under the output_free_v7 protocol. This is a negative external validity result.

limitations: Pairs were produced before any protocol freeze (exploratory/pre-registration status)

Label scheme may differ from synthetic benchmark (real bugs vs SP-transformed fixed code)
